Title: Users that have premium license for Microsoft Defender for Servers (DFS) P2 may not see baseline data

User impact: Users that have premium license for DFS P2 may not see baseline data in the Microsoft Defender portal.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Users that have premium license for Microsoft Defender for Servers (DFS) P2 may not see baseline data

User impact: Users that have premium license for DFS P2 may not see baseline data in the Microsoft Defender portal.

Current status: We've identified a recent service change that introduced a configuration issue that's preventing the baseline data from being communicated to the portal. We're working on reversing this service change to remediate the impact.

Scope of impact: Any user that has a premium license for DFS P2 and is attempting to view baseline data in the Microsoft Defender portal may be impacted.

Root cause: A recent service change that introduced a configuration issue that's preventing the baseline data from being communicated to the portal.

Next update by: Friday, October 30, 2026, at 3:30 AM UTC
